scope: Personal data processed by public and private bodies; 'personal data' is defined narrowly (commercial transactions, automated processing or relevant filing system)
applies_to: Public and private bodies (public bodies include Antigua and Barbuda embassies/consulates abroad)
key_requirements: Data handling principles (notice, disclosure, security, access); data subject access and correction rights
data_categories: Personal data (narrow definition: commercial transactions, automated or filing-system processing); sensitive data needs explicit consent or a listed exception
retention_period: Data may not be retained longer than necessary; it must be destroyed or permanently deleted when no longer required
enforcement_authority: Information Commissioner (established under the Freedom of Information Act 2004)
penalties_range: Sensitive-data offence: up to $200,000 and/or 3 yrs; other offences (individual): up to $50,000 or 3 yrs summary, $100,000 or 5 yrs indictment; body corporate $200,000 / $500,000
notes: Dates from one secondary source (assent 2013-10-28, gazette 2013-11-07); ConsentStack gives 2013-01-01, judged unreliable; Commissioner operational status unclear
